select 'TABLE' as k, c.relname as name,
 pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)/1048576 as total_mb,
 pg_relation_size(c.oid)/1048576 as heap_mb,
 pg_indexes_size(c.oid)/1048576 as idx_mb,
 coalesce(pg_total_relation_size(c.reltoastrelid),0)/1048576 as toast_mb,
 c.reltuples::bigint as est_rows,
 s.n_dead_tup as dead, s.seq_scan, s.idx_scan, s.n_tup_ins as ins, s.n_tup_del as del
from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
left join pg_stat_user_tables s on s.relid=c.oid
where c.relkind='r' and n.nspname='public'
union all
select 'DB', current_database(), pg_database_size(current_database())/1048576, null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null
order by total_mb desc nulls last limit 60
